title: Rav Ada son of Rav Avya
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Kamma 62a, raising an objection to Rav Ashi. But the reading of the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim is Rav Acha son of Rav Avya; and Hyman explains that Yuchasin likewise did not cite Rav Ada son of Rav Avya, because its reading was like the Rif’s.

notes.text: The consulted Bava Kamma has Rav Ada son of Rav Avya. The readings of the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim, and the explanation of the omission in Yuchasin, are Hyman’s reports and inference.
